features.name: nsw_vic_price_ratio
features.description: Ratio of New South Wales electricity price to Victoria electricity price, smoothed to avoid division by zero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a relative price measure that helps a linear model capture regional price disparities.

features.name: nsw_vic_demand_diff
features.description: Difference between New South Wales demand and Victoria demand.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear SVM to directly weight the regional demand imbalance.

features.name: total_demand
features.description: Sum of New South Wales and Victoria electricity demand.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the overall system load, which is a strong driver of market dynamics.

features.name: price_demand_interaction_nsw
features.description: Interaction term between New South Wales price and demand.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes the non-linear relationship between price and demand in NSW to the linear model.

features.name: price_demand_interaction_vic
features.description: Interaction term between Victoria price and demand.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes the non-linear relationship between price and demand in VIC to the linear model.

features.name: transfer_demand_ratio
features.description: Ratio of energy transfer to total system demand.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes the transfer volume against the total load, providing a scale-invariant measure of grid reliance.

features.name: is_peak_period
features.description: Indicator for the second half of the day (period > 0.5), typically corresponding to higher activity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a clear linear separation boundary for time-of-day effects.

features.name: price_spread
features.description: Absolute difference between New South Wales and Victoria prices.
features.expected_model_benefit: Directly feeds the price spread into the linear model, which is crucial for understanding market direction.

features.name: demand_transfer_interaction
features.description: Interaction between total system demand and energy transfer.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps the SVM capture scenarios where high demand coincides with high transfer volumes.

features.name: nsw_price_squared
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear SVM to approximate quadratic responses to extreme price spikes.

features.name: transfer_deviation
features.description: Absolute deviation of the transfer value from its midpoint (0.5).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the magnitude of transfer imbalance regardless of direction, useful for margin-based models.

features.name: market_stress_index
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall market stress based on combined high prices, high demand, and transfer constraints.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, expert-like evaluation of grid conditions that raw linear combinations might miss.
